scope: Direct tools.view_image inspection at original detail of fixed visibility pages2/3 (classes20..36) and near-duplicates page0; local QA metadata summaries only. No model outputs, GPU, training, downloads, old sealed arrays or reserved-confirmation pixels.
method: Limited visual inspection of fixed preselected source/weak/RA contact-sheet panels. This is not expert breed certification or an audit of all1184 photographs/all augmentation epochs.

visibility_summary.decision: Report appearance/recognizability uncertainty and retain these fixed sources. Do not filter solarized/low-contrast examples or modify RA to obtain favorable task performance. Original annotated breed remains the operational training target; actual breed-cue availability is not guaranteed.
visibility_summary.observations_zh: 17例都仍可辨为宠物主体，未见完整主体被移除或只剩背景。但多个RA面板明显反色、伪彩或对比度失真；粗粒度可见性不等于细粒度品种可辨，也不证明标签保持。

per_fixed_example.note: Weak crop zooms/reframes the cat; head and substantial body remain visible. No additional coarse subject loss apparent in RA; breed identity not independently certified.
RA has severe dark/false-color edge and surface changes. Head/body shape remain visible; coat-color and fine appearance cues uncertain.
RA strongly alters background tonal appearance and dark fur/lighting. Head/silhouette remain visible; fine coat/appearance evidence uncertain.
Close face retained, with noticeably flatter/altered color and contrast in RA. Fine color/texture evidence uncertain; not a breed-label certificate.
RA rotates/repositions image and adds visible fill. Face/ears remain largely visible, with altered framing; no complete subject loss.
Face and upper/full body remain visible in weak and RA. No coarse failure observed; fine breed recognition was not tested.
Close head/ears retained. Small tonal/framing differences do not remove the coarse subject; breed cues not certified.
RA darkens/changes contrast across face and fur; cat head/posture retained, but appearance/color evidence is less reliable.
RA has false-color/solarized regions over face/chest and surroundings. Head remains recognizable as a dog; coat-color/texture evidence uncertain.
RA severely recolors fur and face into blue/green/contrasting regions. Dog outline/head remains visible; fine appearance evidence substantially altered.
Dog head and substantial body remain visible; no obvious total-loss or severe recoloring in this fixed RA panel. No expert breed assertion.
RA rotation/reframing and fill are visible; face, ears and torso remain in view. Framing changes can still affect fine evidence.
Cat head and body remain visible across panels; no obvious coarse loss in this draw. Breed preservation not certified.
RA creates pronounced false-color/edge regions on head and skin. Head/torso remain visible but skin/color/texture cues are altered.
Head, ears and upper body remain visible with modest tonal/framing changes. No expert discrimination from neighboring breeds performed.

RA has pronounced false-color over head and large dark/inverted regions. Dog remains visible; ordinary fur/color/texture evidence is substantially altered. Dark regions are not automatically interpreted as geometric occlusion.
Head and body remain visible; modest apparent tone/detail changes. No coarse subject-loss observed, without breed certification.

duplicate_adjudications.evidence_zh: 黑猫的姿态、眼睛/耳朵位置、构图、墙砖及背景结构相同，符合相同照片的分辨率/重编码版本；不是两个独立拍摄样本。
duplicate_adjudications.action_under_predeclared_rule: Remove both IDs from development, without replacement.

duplicate_adjudications.evidence_zh: 犬脸、口舌、毛发轮廓及门框/网门/室内背景的空间关系高度相同，符合相同拍摄的重复/重编码，而不是独立捕获。
duplicate_adjudications.action_under_predeclared_rule: Remove both IDs from train/development, without replacement. This also prevents the known pair crossing the training/development boundary.

duplicate_rule_application.scope: Expected arithmetic from current candidate metadata; not a claim that final fit-manifest has already been written or independently validated.

local_QA_metadata_read.caveat: Mask counts certify neither subject identity nor breed-cue preservation. A ratio slightly above1 is a resampled pixel-count proxy, not a probability of semantic information retained. Only one predeclared draw/epoch is covered.

missing_mask_boundary.interpretation: Unavailable auxiliary foreground proxy, not evidence that the actual photo contains no pet or that RA removed it. The train row has null retention ratios and foreground_proxy_available=false; its zero visible-mask count must not be counted as an augmentation failure.
missing_mask_boundary.decision: Preserve qa-attempt01 failure and source images. No deletion based only on missing/all-background mask. This review does not certify the unviewed missing-mask photographs.

remaining_gates: Combine with parent's fixed pages0/1 and three missing-mask source review; preserve the scope and uncertainty of each reviewer.
Write/freeze final manifest after the predeclared duplicate deletions and validate source-photo IDs, class counts and known duplicate boundaries.
Verify dummy runtime/memory/RNG receipt and formal protocol lock before scientific fitting. This visual review is not hardware approval or evidence of a task effect.
